mainText: Good morning. Futures are sharply higher after Democrats secured control of both chambers of Congress in the midterms, with investors betting a divided Washington limits the scope for sharp policy shifts. Dow futures are up about one and a half percent, the S and P up about one percent, and the Nasdaq up just under one percent. The ten year Treasury yield sits near four point nine percent, down from Tuesday. Biggest premarket movers: Super Micro up nine percent after revenue nearly tripled, A M D up six to seven percent on faster 2027 growth, Block up ten percent after raising its outlook, Arista up six percent on a strong beat, and First Solar up five to six percent as the sweep favors renewables. On the downside, Datadog is down seventeen percent, Fidelity National down fifteen percent, and Tesla down four percent. The I S M services report and Treasury refunding details land later this morning.
